subject: POC billing tranches: time-extension vs short-term discount
messages:

To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:05:00Z
Subject: Short POC extension or discount?

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from the HelioCare team after the demo this morning — engineering loved the latency profile and model fit, but finance is pushing back on the remaining runway. We have two asks:

1) Can we get an extra two weeks on the current 6-week POC at the same committed spend?
2) If an extension isn’t possible, would Redwood consider a limited ``one-off`` discount on the final invoice (we're looking at ~15% on the unused token estimate) so we can justify moving forward internally?

We want to keep momentum and have a short internal review next Thursday. If you can share a clear option set (time extension OR discount + simple SOW language) that would help.

Thanks — Ellen

Subject: Re: Short POC extension or discount?

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and for surfacing the timeline. We want to make this low-friction so you can keep momentum. Two straightforward, mutually exclusive options we can offer today:

Option A — Two-week time extension (no price change)
- Extend current POC window by 14 days.
- No change to committed spend, telemetry and eval hooks remain in place.
- If conversion occurs within the extension, we can credit 50% of overage above the original token forecast toward the first month of committed Dedicated capacity.

Option B — One-off invoice concession (discount)
- Flat 12% credit applied to the final POC invoice (applies only to unused projected tokens).
- No change to timeline or SOW.

Notes / trade-offs:
- Option A keeps the team focused on technical validation (preferred if you need more engineering cycles).
- Option B gives finance an immediate line-item improvement they can approve faster.
- Pricing team would need sign-off for anything deeper than 12% or layered credits.

I attached a 1-page pricing table and a redlineable SOW that shows how we’d document either path. If you prefer, I can also propose a hybrid structure (short 7-day extension + 8% credit) that sits between the two — let me know.

Next steps: Tell me which option you want by Tuesday EOD and I’ll send a final SOW amendment or credit memo.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Team — forwarding HelioCare's ask. They gave a hard internal review next Thursday; they want either +2 weeks or a discount. My proposed public-facing options are in the thread below (Option A: +14 days, Option B: 12% invoice credit on unused tokens).

Questions:
- Can we approve 12% as a one-off concession here or do we need manager sign-off?
- If they pick Option A, can we provide the 50% first-month credit for overage (applies only on the event of immediate conversion) as a standard conversion sweetener?

Context: HelioCare is small but strategic — they have a clear path to purchase if the evaluation drives a single-model deployment. We should avoid stretching credits that set a precedent for similar-sized health-tech customers.

Requested approvals:
- Ben: approve/decline up to 12% concession.
- Laura: confirm legal is OK with the simple SOW amendment language (attached).
- Karthik: want your view on the conversion credit mechanics (finance/packaging).

Thanks — I need to give them a clean yes/no by Tuesday.

—Vanessa

Hi Ellen — thanks again for the quick sync earlier this week. We can do both proposed public options; below is the formalized language so your finance/procurement team can sign off quickly.

Final Offer (pick one):

1) Time Extension — 14 days (no price change)
- POC end date moves from 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-30.
- No immediate invoice change.
- Conversion sweetener: If HelioCare signs a Dedicated capacity commitment within 30 days of the extended POC end date, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the token overage (above the original forecast) to the first month of commit. Credit is non-transferable and applied as an offset to the invoice.

2) Invoice Concession — one-time 12% credit
- A 12% credit applied to the final POC invoice on the unused token forecast line item.
- No changes to dates or SOW.

Hybrid (optional): 7-day extension + 8% credit — if you'd like a middle path we can document that quickly.

If you confirm Option 1 or Option 2 via reply, I’ll send a short amendment (SOW amendment or credit memo) and the DocuSign link. Links are below for quick reference.
